answer: In a plume market, backers stake on honesty; the k-th identity one backer supports costs $25 times k squared. Backing 100 clones costs $8,458,750; 100 honest agents backed once each cost $2,500. Each backing mints one plume certificate for that identity alone. A challenger files a falcon fraud proof; five zephyr auditors rotate every 48 hours to judge it. A proven falcon burns the backing pool, pays the challenger 10 percent, and halves the backer's other certificates. Cloning is buying the same concert seat a hundred times, each ticket pricier than the last, until the scalper goes broke.
